points.K6: 故障电器还会起火爆炸

shots.scene: 欣欣站在培训室的白板前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard in a bright training room and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全岗位面试，十五道电气题。

shots.scene: 熔断器、灭火器、电线、灯泡四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cartridge fuse, a fire extinguisher, a coiled power cord and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 从保护装置、火灾，到照明都有。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着衬衫，拿着空白简历，一脸发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a neat shirt holds a blank resume at a desk, looking worried.
shots.narration: 阿杰下周要面试安全员岗位。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着一页空白的用电题目，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a blank page with a lightning bolt icon and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 电气题这部分，他心里没底。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一叠空白卡片走过来，欣欣跟在后面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a stack of blank cards, followed by the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 小研和欣欣来帮他模拟面试。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起空白问题卡，阿杰坐直了身子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank question card and the young male student sits up straight.
shots.narration: 问一题，答一题。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起问题卡，卡上画着熔断器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing a cartridge fuse icon.
shots.narration: 第一问：电路里为什么装熔断器？

shots.scene: 一根导线上挤满了电器图标，导线渐渐发红
shots.prompt_en: A wire connected to too many appliance icons slowly glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 用电太多，电流超标，线会发热。

shots.scene: 熔断器里的细丝熔断，电路变暗，导线恢复正常颜色
shots.prompt_en: The thin wire inside a fuse melts, the circuit goes dark and the overheated cable returns to normal color. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器先熔断，切断电路保护线路。

shots.scene: 配电箱里一排断路器，小研指着其中一个
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at one of a row of circuit breakers in an open distribution box.
shots.narration: 第二问：断路器是干什么的？

shots.scene: 断路器拨杆向上灯亮，向下灯灭
shots.prompt_en: A circuit breaker lever moves up and a lamp turns on, then moves down and the lamp turns off. No people.
shots.narration: 它是接通和断开电流的开关装置。

shots.scene: 电路过载时断路器自动跳下
shots.prompt_en: A circuit breaker lever drops by itself when an overload arrow appears on the wire. No people.
shots.narration: 出现故障，它还会自动跳闸。

shots.scene: 插座冒烟起火，旁边一桶水打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A smoking wall socket with small flames, and a bucket of water beside it crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第三问：电气着火，为什么不能泼水？

shots.scene: 水流里出现闪电符号，连到人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A stream of water with a lightning bolt symbol running along it toward a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 水能导电，泼水的人可能触电。

shots.scene: 水碰到带电导线，两线之间冒出火花
shots.prompt_en: Water splashes onto live wires and sparks jump between them. No people.
shots.narration: 还会引起短路，火势更大。

shots.scene: 地上横着一根电源线，人形图标被绊了一下
shots.prompt_en: A power cord stretched across the floor, and a person pictogram trips over it. No people.
shots.narration: 第四问：电源线为什么不放地上？

shots.scene: 推车轮子压过地上的电线，外皮破裂
shots.prompt_en: A cart wheel rolls over a cord on the floor and the outer insulation cracks. No people.
shots.narration: 一是容易被踩坏、压坏。

shots.scene: 人形图标被电线绊倒的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person tripping over a cord on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 二是会把人绊倒。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起问题卡，卡上画着一双靴子和一块垫子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing icons of a pair of boots and a floor mat.
shots.narration: 第五问：不靠跳闸，怎样防对地电击？

shots.scene: 配电柜前地面铺着绝缘垫
shots.prompt_en: An insulating rubber mat laid on the floor in front of an electrical cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 一是用橡胶绝缘垫。

shots.scene: 老李穿着绝缘靴站在绝缘垫上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on the insulating mat wearing insulating boots.
shots.narration: 二是穿橡胶绝缘靴。

shots.scene: 人形图标和地面之间隔着一层盾牌，电流过不去
shots.prompt_en: A shield layer between a person pictogram and the ground, blocking a current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电流找不到通路，就不容易触电。

shots.section_title: 故障电器还会起火爆炸
shots.scene: 一台外壳破损的仪器冒出火花
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a cracked case gives off sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 第六问：故障电器还有什么危害？
overlay: 故障电器还会起火爆炸

shots.section_title: 故障电器还会起火爆炸
shots.scene: 火花引燃旁边的纸箱
shots.prompt_en: Sparks from a faulty instrument ignite a cardboard box next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 除了电人、坏设备，还会引起火灾。

shots.section_title: 故障电器还会起火爆炸
shots.scene: 火花飘向易燃气体云图标，出现爆炸符号
shots.prompt_en: Sparks drift toward a flammable vapor cloud icon and an explosion symbol appears. No people.
shots.narration: 遇到易燃气体，甚至会爆炸。

shots.scene: 小研指着吹风机铭牌上回字形的双方框标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a double square symbol on the blank nameplate of a hair dryer.
shots.narration: 第七问：怎样认出双重绝缘电器？

shots.scene: 一个正方形套在另一个正方形里的标志放大
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a symbol made of one square inside another square. No people.
shots.narration: 看铭牌：两个方框套在一起。

shots.scene: 电器剖面：内层绝缘外再包一层绝缘外壳
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of an appliance showing an inner insulation layer wrapped by a second insulating outer shell. No people.
shots.narration: 它有两层绝缘，多一道保险。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一把电钻，准备插电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up an electric drill and reaches for the plug.
shots.narration: 第八问：电动工具用前先查哪？

shots.scene: 放大镜对着插头检查，插脚完好
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a power plug showing straight pins and an intact body. No people.
shots.narration: 一查插头：有无破裂、松动、烧焦。

shots.scene: 手顺着电源线一路摸过去检查外皮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand running along a power cord to check its outer insulation.
shots.narration: 二查电线：外皮有没有破损。

shots.scene: 狭小的设备坑里放着一盏手持行灯
shots.prompt_en: A portable hand lamp placed inside a narrow equipment pit with damp walls. No people.
shots.narration: 第九问：潮湿受限处，行灯最高几伏？

shots.scene: 行灯连到一个小变压器图标，旁边有交流和直流符号
shots.prompt_en: A hand lamp connected to a small safety transformer icon, with an alternating current symbol and a direct current symbol beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 交流不超过25伏，直流不超过50伏。

shots.scene: 人形图标手握带电导线，闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram gripping a live wire with a lightning bolt symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第十问：有人触电还粘在电上？

shots.scene: 一只手拉下墙上的总开关
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand pulling down the main switch lever on a wall panel.
shots.narration: 第一步：能断电，马上断电。

shots.scene: 用干燥木棍挑开导线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry wooden stick pushing a live wire away from a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 断不了电，用不导电的东西挑开。

shots.scene: 老李跪在训练假人旁做人工呼吸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer kneels beside a training manikin and gives rescue breaths.
shots.narration: 然后给他做人工呼吸。

shots.scene: 四个图标：闪电、波浪线与直线、心形、电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a wavy line beside a straight line, a heart and a current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一问：什么让电击更严重？

shots.scene: 电压表指针由低到高，交流与直流符号并排
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter needle rising from low to high, next to an alternating current symbol and a direct current symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 一看电压高低，二看交流直流。

shots.scene: 心形图标旁一个虚弱的人形，再旁边是变粗的电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon beside a weak-looking person pictogram, then a current arrow that grows thicker. No people.
shots.narration: 三看身体状况，四看电流大小。

shots.scene: 四个图标一起亮起，人形外加警告三角
shots.prompt_en: All four icons light up together around a person pictogram with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 这些叠加，伤害就更重。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起问题卡，卡上三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing three icons: a lightning bolt, a flame and an explosion symbol.
shots.narration: 第十二问：用电有哪三大危害？

shots.scene: 闪电、火焰、爆炸三个图标依次放大
shots.prompt_en: A lightning bolt, a flame and an explosion symbol enlarge one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 电击、火灾和爆炸。

shots.scene: 老李在断电的配电箱旁，用空白表盘的测试仪测量
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures a switched off distribution circuit with a test meter that has a blank dial.
shots.narration: 第十三问：绝缘电阻测试干什么？

shots.scene: 相线和中性线外有完好的绝缘层，没有电流漏向地面
shots.prompt_en: Two wires with intact insulation, and no current arrows leaking down to the ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 确认相线、中性线没有漏电到地。

shots.scene: 室外变压器四周围着高高的围栏，门上挂高压警告标志
shots.prompt_en: An outdoor transformer surrounded by a tall fence, with a high voltage warning sign on the locked gate. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四问：户外高压设备怎么防护？

shots.scene: 围栏高度旁有一个向上的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A vertical arrow next to the tall fence showing its height. No people.
shots.narration: 建筑外的要用围栏隔开，

shots.scene: 阿杰在围栏外停步，抬头看围栏
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops outside the fence and looks up at its height.
shots.narration: 围栏最低约2.4米，也就是8英尺。

shots.scene: 昏暗的工作台，阿杰眯着眼看仪表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student squints at a meter on a dimly lit workbench.
shots.narration: 第十五问：照明不好有什么后果？

shots.scene: 打哈欠的人形和打叉的表格图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a yawning person and a checklist with a wrong mark. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛疲劳，容易出差错，

shots.scene: 皱眉的人形和摔倒的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a frowning stressed person and a person falling down. No people.
shots.narration: 人会紧张，还容易出事故。

shots.scene: 疲劳、差错、紧张、事故四个图标连成一串
shots.prompt_en: Four icons linked in a chain: a yawning face, a wrong mark, a stressed face and an accident symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 疲劳、差错、紧张，最后是事故。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上排着熔断器、断路器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard showing a fuse icon and a circuit breaker icon.
shots.narration: 熔断器、断路器，护住线路。

shots.scene: 水桶打叉、电线不落地、绝缘靴三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a water bucket crossed out, a cord under a floor cover and a pair of insulating boots. No people.
shots.narration: 着火不泼水，电线不落地，绝缘防护。

shots.scene: 插头放大镜、双方框标志、行灯三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a magnifying glass over a plug, a double square symbol and a hand lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 查插头电线，认标志，行灯低电压。

shots.scene: 开关、木棍、电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a switch lever turned off, a dry wooden stick and a telephone with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 有人触电：先断电，再人工呼吸。

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地走进面试室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks confidently into an interview room.
shots.narration: 阿杰信心满满去面试。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 十五问都答对，安全用电，下次见！
